name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
summary: Greta Mosshoof asks you to use Purified Moon Well Water on the four braziers of protection in Shadow Hold, Felwood. Then return to her at the Emerald Sanctuary.

sections.title: At Shadow Hold
sections.body: Greta Mosshoof sends you from the Emerald Sanctuary to Shadow Hold in Felwood. The four braziers of protection are to be doused with Purified Moon Well Water before you return to her.

faq.q: What does Greta Mosshoof ask me to do?
faq.answer: Greta Mosshoof asks you to douse the four braziers of protection in Shadow Hold with Purified Moon Well Water, then return to her at the Emerald Sanctuary.
The four braziers of protection are within Shadow Hold in Felwood.

faq.q: What do I use to douse them?
faq.answer: Use Purified Moon Well Water to douse the four braziers of protection.
Return to Greta Mosshoof at the Emerald Sanctuary.

attribution: In-game quest text: Dousing the Flames of Protection
